caption: The video captures a calm coastal scene at twilight, where a glassy wet-sand flat fills the lower frame and mirrors a broken cloud deck overhead. A dark conifer treeline and rocky pebble beach anchor the right side, with a small light-colored building at the far edge, while scattered stones sit motionless in the shallow foreground. Across the excerpt, the overhead clouds drift and deform, the central dark mass and upper-right streaks shifting slightly. The warm glow along the left horizon intensifies, and a bright sun point near the center-left becomes more distinct as orange and pink tones deepen. The mirror-like reflection tracks these sky changes, gaining warmer color, while the fixed camera holds the treeline steady.
relations: Overhead clouds drift and deform -> their reflection in the wet sand shifts correspondingly.
Horizon glow intensifies and sun emerges -> the mirrored reflection gains warmer orange and pink tones.
Fixed camera and steady treeline -> scattered foreground stones remain motionless in the shallow water.
